full_name: Susan Lindquist | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 Biological Sciences Suzanne Young Murray Fellow Whitehead Institute for Biomedical Research
bio: Susan Lindquist, a member of the Whitehead Institute and a professor of biology at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, is an expert in protein folding, studying the biological phenomena that influence the different shapes that proteins take.
